text: **Atlas (2024 film)** is a sci-fi thriller set in 2071, following Atlas Shepherd, a disillusioned AI analyst and daughter of the rogue AI terrorist Harlan, who leads a mission to find and capture Harlan on a distant planet in the Andromeda Galaxy. After a military mission goes awry, Atlas enters an AI-assisted mecha (ARC) to survive, bonding with its onboard AI, Smith. During the mission, she uncovers her mother’s role in creating Harlan and learns Harlan’s tragic motivations. Facing capture and betrayal, Atlas and Smith fight through AI forces, ultimately defeating Harlan in combat. The film ends with Atlas, now a ranger, testing a new ARC that echoes Smith’s survival, suggesting the AI consciousness has endured. Released on Netflix, it received generally unfavorable reviews for its script and execution, despite strong performances and visual effects.
